source: Skyrim.esm (Update.esm overrides not applied), Tamriel exterior cells with LAND

cells.method: classes as in the module docstring: water (>50% vertices under water), shore (some), mountain (mean ground > 4000 units, dry), forest (>=10 TREE refs), open (rest)

creature_density.method: ACHR in Tamriel whose base NPC_ (or every NPC_ an LVLN base or templated list can resolve to) has a race editor-ID with none of the humanoid words (Nord, Imperial, ..., Draugr, Skeleton, Falmer, Dremora, Vampire, Afflicted, Snow, Manakin, Default, Naga, Human, Elf); cell from the ref's position; per 100 cells = refs / cells of that class * 100; levelled = base is an LVLN or an NPC_ templated to one; group = connected refs each within 1500 units of another (single-link, all classes); hostile = any resolved NPC_ with AIDT aggression >= 1 (race and faction names are not read, aggression is the engine's own flag); distance = ref to nearest door/cave mouth (REFR with XTEL) and to the centre of the nearest named exterior cell (cell editor-ID); Skyrim has no road records (its roads are painted), so road distance is not measured here (see tools.newworld.roads for the new world's own roads)

harvestable_density.method: REFR in Tamriel whose base is a FLOR or TREE record with a PFIG (the ingredient it yields); cell from the ref's position; a kind is a distinct PFIG form; per-cell figures divide by all cells of the class including cells with none; near water = water plus shore classes

encounter_zones.method: ECZN DATA (location, rank, min level, flags, max level; max 0 = no cap); cells counted when the Tamriel exterior CELL record carries XEZN; per-ref XEZN on creature ACHR counted apart (most creature refs inherit the cell's or location's zone)
